response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth, open-source contributions, and diverse experience across architectures and languages, but lacks explicit evidence of leadership, UML expertise, German proficiency (only 'Basic'), and direct experience in IT consulting or client-facing architecture advisory — key requirements for this executive-level role.
strengths: Extensive open-source contributions with real-world impact (e.g., GISCollective)
Proven full-stack expertise across multiple languages and environments (DLang, Node.js, Linux)
Strong track record in mentoring and workshops, indicating knowledge-sharing ability
concerns: German language proficiency is only 'Basic', falling far short of C1 requirement
No clear evidence of architectural leadership, UML modeling, or client advisory experience
Lacks documented experience in IT consulting, requirements management, or compliance/risk frameworks
